correctness.rationale: Exact all-s proof is complete: phi fibers split into order-three orbits with two fixed points iff s even; cubic reducibility counts give \(I_s=(2q+2)/3\) or \(I_s=(2q-2)/3\). Norm-one trace identity classifies 3I non-base-field x plus two possible cube roots; \(nK_s/6\) counts unordered distinct triples. No weight-one/two words exist. Direct enumeration s=1..5 and independent phi image census agree. Finite tests are not universal proofs.

value.rationale: The first nonzero coefficient of the weight enumerator is a natural quantitative decoding invariant for this BCH family: the motivating papers leave it undetermined despite settling minimum distance. A uniform exact formula and per-coordinate incidence, with an intrinsic parity transition, meaningfully refine existence to the full minimum-weight layer. Not just numerical tabulation or a restatement of \(d=3\).
